title: Mei's Piano Practice
subtitle: 考点：坚持练习 / tap, finger, proudly
passage: Mei is thirteen, and she has been learning the piano for five years. At first, she hated practice. Her fingers were stiff, and she made many mistakes. Her mother often found her tapping her feet and looking out of the window instead of playing.

Then Mei's teacher gave her a new piece, a slow and beautiful folk song. 'Play it as if you are telling a story,' the teacher said. Mei began to enjoy it. She practised for twenty minutes every day and listened to a recording to learn from great pianists. Last month, she played the folk song at the school concert. When the audience clapped, she smiled proudly. 'Practice is not fun every day,' she said, 'but the result is worth it.'
vocab: finger 手指 · tap 轻敲 · practise 练习 · recording 录音 · audience 观众 · proudly 自豪地
